response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack/backend engineer with 14+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role. His career trajectory (Staff-level titles, mostly product/infra generalist work) also doesn't demonstrate the Principal-level cross-team technical leadership or systemic multi-team platform ownership the role requires.
strengths: Extensive (14+ years) hands-on engineering experience across multiple languages and paradigms (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript/JS)
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring through workshops, talks, and founding an open-source platform
Experience with distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-metrics platform experience, which is central to this role
No demonstrated multi-team/cross-org technical leadership at Principal (IC6) scope — career progression tops out at Staff/Senior titles
No mention of Python, data analysis/statistical methods, or telemetry systems needed for experimentation quality and bias detection

key_factors.factor: No evidence of Principal-level cross-team technical leadership or systemic platform ownership
Strong general engineering breadth and seniority (years, languages, distributed systems)
